The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the following dates.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2025 (Friday) through January 15, 2026 (Friday)

【What to Know During the Closure】

• You cannot use the library's reading rooms, borrow books, or return books at the Children's Library during this time.

• If you have reserved materials set for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Hanno City Library instead.

• Book drop boxes will remain available for returns throughout the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
